notes:
Summary/engineering notes:
- Workload: session-based personalization + quick chat assistant inside streaming video product. Tight latency constraints for UI interactions (interactive personalization change within video).
- Traffic profile: baseline 400 RPS, peaks ~2,000 RPS for big events. Typical prompt length short (<=128 tokens), occasional longer context for session history (up to 512).
- Latency targets: p95 <= 40ms for 1-2 token completions, p95 <= 100ms for typical 32-token responses. Cost sensitivity high — must show unit economics comparable to current on-prem cluster.
- Performance levers requested: dynamic batching (max batch latency budget 8-12ms), prefix/KV caching for repeated session context, aggressive quantization options (4-bit/INT8, interested in AWQ or GPTQ profiles), kernel selection guidance.
- Benchmarks: customer asked Redwood to run bench with three variants: (A) quantized Llama-2-13b int4, (B) Mistral-class 7B quantized, (C) Redwood-verified optimized 13B with burst Dedicated instance. Provide p50/p95/p99, token/sec, GPU utilization, cost per 1M tokens. Also want throughput vs latency curves and batching tradeoff plots.
- Reliability: need automatic fallback policy to smaller model when Dedicated pool saturated; canary rollouts for model updates; multi-region fallback to EU for residency.
- Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, require audit logs for inference events (token-level redaction option), bring-your-own-key (KMS) required for Private; retention controls for user PII.
- Quote from CTO on call: "If latency slips by 20ms, product ops notices — we need hard guarantees or a safe degradation path."
- Org decision factors: cost per active session, ability to operate in VPC with regional KMS, observability for token-level costs and latency hotspots.
- Internal ask: provide dedicated capacity scenarios (1x, 3x, 10x cluster sizes) + expected autoscaling behavior and estimated monthly run-rate.
- POC success criteria: hit p95 targets on workload harness for at least 72 hours under synthetic spike test; <15% increase in cost vs current optimized on-prem baseline using quantization and caching.
- Risk notes: network egress and edge node connectivity could add unpredictable latency; legal needs firm data residency language before moving to Private.
- Stubs/links: drive pricing deck (link above), fireflies meeting id ff-2026-02-18-34567, Jira RDW-9341 (request for dedicated capacity sizing doc).
